label: National Assembly
sub: Assembly extended 6,320 municipal officials' terms to 2029 (Aug 24), canceling scheduled municipal elections, atop the earlier co-presidency term extension and 'traitor' party reform

label: El Carmen Presidential Compound
sub: Seat of the Ortega-Murillo co-presidency; Ortega delivered the 'never again' elections speech nearby on July 19

label: La Gaceta (Official Gazette)
sub: Publishes constitutional reforms and decrees consolidating one-party rule

label: El Chipote (Dirección de Auxilio Judicial)
sub: Maximum-security facility where Bishop Abelardo Mata was held on June 29 before house arrest

label: Bilwi (Puerto Cabezas)
sub: Home community of Indigenous leader Brooklyn Rivera, arrested here in Sept. 2023; died in state custody May 30, 2026

label: Bluefields / South Caribbean Coast
sub: Caribbean coast Indigenous and Afro-descendant communities represented by Rivera's YATAMA movement

label: Diocese of Estelí
sub: Bishop Emeritus Juan Abelardo Mata's diocese; ordinations banned March 2026, bishop detained June 29

label: Diocese of Matagalpa
sub: Diocese of exiled Bishop Rolando Álvarez, deported to the Vatican in Jan. 2024; still without a resident bishop

label: Diocese of Jinotega
sub: Diocese of exiled Bishop Carlos Herrera, president of Nicaragua's bishops' conference; ordinations banned

label: Diocese of Siuna
sub: One of four dioceses without a resident bishop; ordinations of priests and deacons banned by decree

label: Managua Metropolitan Area (Catholic Church properties)
sub: Site of confiscated church properties amid a campaign rights groups say has seized 40+ Church assets nationwide

label: Peñas Blancas / Costa Rica Border
sub: Main land crossing used by Nicaraguans fleeing political persecution and exile toward Costa Rica

label: San José, Costa Rica
sub: Largest hub of the Nicaraguan exile and refugee community, including displaced clergy and opposition figures

label: US Embassy, Managua
sub: Coordinates US sanctions designations and public statements on the Ortega-Murillo government's rights record

label: Port of Corinto
sub: Nicaragua's principal Pacific port; export hub exposed to phased-in US Section 301 tariffs on non-CAFTA-DR goods

label: Chinandega Agro-Export Region
sub: Sugar, peanut and agricultural export zone whose US-bound shipments face the new phased tariff schedule

label: Las Mercedes Free Trade Zone
sub: Managua-area textile and apparel free-trade zone reliant on preferential US market access now eroded by tariffs

label: Tegucigalpa, Honduras
sub: Secondary regional hub for Nicaraguan exiles, journalists and clergy transiting or resettling outside Costa Rica

label: Centro Momotombo
sub: China-financed $42M surveillance and monitoring center inaugurated Aug. 22 with cameras, drones and robot dogs; framed as disaster response, run without independent oversight

label: Juigalpa National Penitentiary System
sub: Isaías Castro Ruiz held in solitary confinement since Dec. 2021; IACHR granted precautionary measures Aug. 16 citing risk to his life and health
